recent.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers wish to celebrate the life and legacy of groundbreaking labor activist and civil rights icon Dolores Huerta, who has passed away at age 96. We send our deepest condolences to her family, her colleagues, her friends and her legions of supporters and allies. https://t.co/UNT1275CHn
